dataset_package: Mumbai Urban Stormwater Flood Prediction System

sample_area_pilot.description: Kurla / Kalina / Mithi River Basin (most flood-prone urban basin in Mumbai)

warning_levels.name: Advisory / Yellow
warning_levels.action: Alert ward control rooms; clear surface grates

warning_levels.name: Watch / Orange
warning_levels.action: Stage portable dewatering pumps; caution low-lying roads

warning_levels.name: Warning / Red
warning_levels.action: Deploy NDRF/BMC emergency teams; divert road & rail traffic

warning_levels.name: Severe / Emergency
warning_levels.action: Mass evacuation of vulnerable basements and riverbanks

spatial_cv_folds.fold_0: Island City South (Wards A, B, C, D, E)
spatial_cv_folds.fold_1: Island City North (Wards F/N, F/S, G/N, G/S)
spatial_cv_folds.fold_2: Eastern Suburbs South (Wards L, M/E, M/W)
spatial_cv_folds.fold_3: Eastern Suburbs North (Wards N, S, T)
spatial_cv_folds.fold_4: Western Suburbs (Wards H, K, P, R)
